about: A pool to measure how late the filler's fills land (ops/sim_keeper.py --measure), not to sell: one line of 1 000 for 9 USDC, so 160 locked, and the widest fill window, 60 blocks, so that a late fill is measured and not lapsed. The first pool's window is set from what it measures. Its one code, MEASURE, is the creator's own with no share: every sale names a code.
terms_text: Simulated pool for measuring fills, testnet. Not for sale. Simulated pool, testnet. Both stages are paper exams on nobody's money; prices are testnet USDC. An exam costs the price of its line: 1 000 for 9. Each stage: profit target 10 % of the size, no more than 6 % below the starting balance, no more than 3 % below the day's first snapshot (equity with open profit, taken in the first minutes of the UTC day), leverage at most 10x on BTC and ETH and 5x on SOL, thirty days at most, with no minimum of trading days. A fill takes the book's price, never better than the oracle's and at most 1.5 % worse, and pays 0.045 % of its notional, Hyperliquid's taker fee. Whoever passes the exam starts the stage within seven days; whoever passes the stage is paid 8 % of the size, once, 72 hours after the payout is claimed, which the platform's keeper does as soon as the stage has passed (later, in the order payouts came due, if the pool does not hold enough then), unless the platform's checker stops it before then with a reason written on chain: opposite positions with another account of the platform, or that and wallets linked. A stopped payout's money stays in the pool. Every exam is bought with a trading group's code, which the pool's creator sets with the address of the group's owner and the owner's share, none or 40 to 60 %; once a sale names a code, neither changes. When the creator takes money out of the pool, each code's owner is sent its share of the profit taken (what is above the payouts owed, held and kept, and above what the creator put in, less the platform's part) in the part of every price the pool took that its code's sales brought. The platform takes 0.5 % of each price and of each withdrawal, and 1 HYPE to open the pool.
